chunks: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
Who is worshipped, not doubted in His existence, whose religion is not denied, and whose creation is not rejected,
the testimony of one whose intention was true, whose entry (into faith) was pure, whose certainty was sincere, and whose scales (of good deeds) were heavy.
ai.seo_question: What are the qualities of a true believer's testimony of faith according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) expands the Shahadah by affirming Allah's absolute perfection, free from any defect or doubt, and links this theological certainty to the spiritual integrity of the believer. This passage, found in the context of worldly transience, underscores that true faith requires a purified intention and unwavering conviction, which serve as the foundation for enduring divine blessings.
